title: Shanghai Tower
blurb: Gensler’s 632 m twisted supertall in Pudong, completed 2015: nine stacked zones wrapped in a double glass skin, the triangular outer wall spiralling 120 degrees around a circular inner wall.

systems.name: Foundation
systems.description: A concrete mat on more than a thousand bore piles driven deep into the soft Shanghai soil.

systems.name: Podium
systems.description: The five-storey, 36.9 m podium with retail, banking hall and conference functions at the tower base.

systems.name: Concrete core
systems.description: The 90-by-90-foot concrete core that carries the tower, with express elevator shuttle shafts.

systems.name: Super-columns
systems.description: Twelve composite super-columns ringing the core, tapering with the tower.

systems.name: Outrigger trusses
systems.description: Belt and outrigger trusses tying the core to the perimeter columns at zone boundaries.

systems.name: Inner curtain wall
systems.description: The circular inner glass curtain wall enclosing the occupied floors.

systems.name: Twisted outer skin
systems.description: The cam-shaped triangular outer glass skin, twisting 120 degrees from base to tip.

systems.name: Sky lobbies
systems.description: Garden atriums in the double-skin cavity at each zone boundary, open to the sky lobbies.

systems.name: Crown
systems.description: The parapet crown and the 1,000-tonne tuned mass damper that steadies the tower in typhoons.
